purpose: śrī 3 sveṣṭadevatā prītyarthaṃ navagṛha praveśa aśvasālā pratiṣṭhā deśabalyārccana pūjā nimityarthaṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi
notes: The colophon contains a saṅkalpa formula naming King Bhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur (Jayabhūpatīndravarman) as the yajamāna for the worship on the occasion of entering a new house and consecrating a horse stable, but gives no date or place of copying.
